business_summary: Murphy Oil Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an oil and gas exploration and production company in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It explores for and produces crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids. Murphy Oil Corporation was formerly known as Murphy Corporation and changed its name to Murphy Oil Corporation in 1964. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
business_summary_ko: Murphy Oil Corporation은 자회사와 함께 미국, 캐나다 및 국제적으로 석유 및 가스 탐사 및 생산 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 원유, 천연가스, 천연가스 액체를 탐색하고 생산합니다. Murphy Oil Corporation은 이전에 Murphy Corporation으로 알려졌으며 1964년에 Murphy Oil Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1950년에 설립되었으며 텍사스주 휴스턴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
